voice.basis: the channel's established narrator (same id as Zombie Ant and Zombie Snail); confirmed with creative_list_voices on 2026-10-31

prompt: [energetic, curious] If you blocked this one protein, your muscles could grow WAY bigger. [brisk, explaining] It's called myostatin, and it acts like a brake on muscle growth. [slightly eerie] But some animals are born without that brake. [building] And their muscles grow FREAKISHLY HUGE. [intrigued, quick] Scientists are even developing drugs that block it in humans. [lower, like an unexpected discovery] But here's the weird part. [knowing] Bigger muscles don't always mean more strength. [eerie, wry] So you could end up looking SUPERHUMAN without actually being super strong.
prompt_note: The approved words, verbatim (production/NARRATION_LOCKED.txt). Capitals mark the brief's emphasis words ('WAY' is capitalised in the approved script itself); the bracket tags direct delivery and are not spoken.
generated_once: One run of two variations (the connector default), 2 x 581.9 credits. No regeneration.

takes.why_not: weaker emphasis: 'WAY' +3.7 dB, 'huge' +5.2 dB, 'superhuman' +0.2 dB over the median word

takes.asr: zipformer and whisper base.en: homophones only (brake/break, super strong/superstrong, superhuman/super human; zipformer misspells myostatin)

edits: Seven sentence gaps (measured below -45 dBFS) shortened to 0.24 s, except 0.36 s before and 0.30 s after 'But here's the weird part': 1.59 s removed in all, each cut in the middle of a silent run with a 12 ms equal-power crossfade. Every word is used sample for sample: no time-stretch, no pitch or gain change. See tools/make_narration.py.
word_timing: local sherpa-onnx Zipformer token timestamps snapped to measured pause onsets, re-measured on the edited master (tools/align_zipformer.py -> audio/narration/master_zipformer.json)
listening: Not listened to in real time: this environment has no audio playback. Selection by two ASR models, pause and level measurement.
